# Retro Terminal

Retro Terminal pairs an amber-phosphor terminal dark mode with a black-and-white Original Macintosh light mode. Monospace typography, square corners, subtle CRT scanlines, a blinking block cursor, always-underlined links and a minimal UI carry the vintage computing look.

![Retro Terminal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meimakes/obsidian-retro-terminal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Retro Terminal"
    author: "meimakes"
    repo:   "meimakes/obsidian-retro-terminal-theme"
    slug:   "retro-terminal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/retro-terminal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/meimakes/obsidian-retro-terminal-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meimakes/obsidian-retro-terminal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style your vault with vintage computing aesthetics: an amber-phosphor terminal dark mode and a black-and-white Original Macintosh light mode. Apply monospace typography, square corners, subtle CRT scanlines, a blinking block cursor, always-underlined links and a minimal UI for a crisp retro workspace."
}
```
